tutorial.pitch: A short match against the exercise command: controls, cities, production, freighters, aircraft and the aim of the game in twelve steps.
tutorial.offerText: In a short match, the tutorial walks you through the controls and the aim of Dominion of Steam: moving units, capturing cities, production, freighters, aircraft and combat. It takes about ten minutes, and you can stop at any time.
tutorial.offerHint: You can find it at the top of the situation report at any time.
